source_window.selection_rule: Close the seven zero-portable-source-review-exposure refs remaining from the cached private 32-source pool after the priority-five and reconstructed-eleven receipts. For sources already adjudicated elsewhere, this artifact reconciles review exposure without changing scientific authority; for newly reviewed sources it applies the same durable-reopen/same-information reducer gate.

sources.title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
sources.note: This source already contributed to canonical scientific adjudication. Aggregate capability/security behavior separates by scope and memory method, while the strongest literal-envelope AWM discrepancy changes executor compatibility and therefore does not isolate a new self-evolution causal primitive. The unresolved PORT-013 executable-envelope object remains evidence-blocked rather than scientifically promoted: released provenance lacks the exact per-trajectory native-call units required by the frozen support contract. This receipt records source-review exposure only and does not supersede those existing adjudications.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Scope/granularity remains an observable effect-heterogeneity variable; no matched same-information residual forces a different prediction.
No released provenance-audited per-trajectory native function-call units satisfy the frozen PORT-013 join/identity contract; synthetic substitution is forbidden.

sources.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
sources.note: The paper strongly establishes that memory-based self-improving agents are order-sensitive: default easy-to-hard ordering can yield apparent improvement whereas shuffled orders can degrade performance, and adding rubrics/environment feedback during memory construction recovers only part of that degradation. This is high-quality motivation for path dependence, but its decisive observables are downstream success and memory content shaped by the ordered history. It does not measure an outcome-independent order-only uptake/state/decision residual after a strongest path-integrated baseline receives the same ordered history, task/content, feedback and lineage information. It therefore strengthens the existing P15 closure rather than reopening it.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: A same-task-set/order performance reversal remains closure support unless a pre-outcome uptake/state/decision observable has repeatable residual beyond a same-information path-integrated continual-learning baseline.

sources.title: Harness Continual Learning: Continual Adaptation Beyond Model Parameters
sources.note: HCL is already represented in durable memory. Its Continual Evaluator commits a candidate harness after checking current improvement, historical retention and validity, and its retention sweeps expose harness-level forgetting. Once the strongest baseline receives the same current-gain, retention-risk, validity, interaction and budget information, this is a constrained stability-plasticity/Pareto commitment decision. The source does not provide matched candidate updates for which a harness-specific hidden structural state forces a different commit decision.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No pair matched on current gain, historical retention risk, validity, component interactions and budget is separated by an irreducible harness-specific state.

sources.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
sources.note: EnvHarness wraps a frozen environment with executable Setup/Rule/Link-style components while preserving the original verifier; EnvRigger observes the current black-box policy, diagnoses weaknesses, writes candidate components and validates them on fresh rollouts, with accepted wrappers persisting as the policy improves. This is genuine policy-conditioned environment co-adaptation, but the current evidence does not isolate a new co-evolution primitive beyond adaptive curriculum/environment design plus verifier-guided program synthesis and distribution shaping. There is no matched factorial that equalizes generated-task/environment distribution, designer state, learner state, harness information and training budget while a distinct persistent co-evolution state forces an opposite future-learning prediction.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Generated-task/environment distribution, designer adaptation state, memory/harness information, learner state and training budget are not jointly matched while varying an independent persistent co-evolution variable.
No preregistered matched factorial demonstrates a repeatable non-additive held-out interaction beyond curriculum allocation, environment/expert-set quality and contextual adaptation.

sources.title: Bringing analytic rigor to agentic AI for science: The Brain Researcher platform for neuroimaging data analysis
sources.note: Brain Researcher is strong component evidence for governed automatic research: commitment cards freeze admissible analyses and criteria; claim cards bind evidence, provenance and claim state; multiverse analyses expose sensitivity; and two extended episodes turn intermediate evidence into researcher-approved frozen successor analyses. However, the paper explicitly says the separately initiated sessions without Brain Researcher were not matched controls and cannot establish that the harness caused transition to a frozen follow-up. Its HCP search is also an adaptive selection process followed by selector audit and frozen evaluation. Therefore this source supports Research-OS control-plane design but does not identify a new irreducible scientific self-evolution object.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Adaptive search and selected-successor gains are not shown to leave a residual after matching candidate count, search depth, verification/selection rule and evaluation sample size.

system_component_support: explicit researcher authority for non-formalizable judgments

sources.title: Reinforcement Learning to Harness Approximation Errors for Long-Time Quantum Simulation
sources.note: RL-Trotter formulates adaptive step-size choice as an MDP and trains a DDPG policy on low-dimensional conserved-quantity observations. The apparent self-correction is long-horizon within-episode control: later Trotter errors compensate earlier ones under a learned policy. The agent artifact is pretrained and then deployed or optionally fine-tuned; the paper does not study autonomous persistent self-modification across tasks. It is therefore standard sequential RL/control evidence outside the current self-evolution scientific scope.

sources.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
sources.note: The existing contradiction screen already gives AI4AI-Bench maximal admissible reuse: recognized training-algorithm modifications show a strong endpoint association, but the released traces do not expose a recognition-positive prefix where the agent has already selected a qualifying algorithmic strategy and later fails before execution. Higher reasoning effort simultaneously changes search/exploration, compute and the frequency of making algorithmic modifications. Thus the source supports the strategy-family endpoint without satisfying the V19 state/recognition opposite-prediction gate.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No recognition-positive prefix with a same-information state residual; reasoning effort is inseparable from broader search/exploration and compute in the released aggregate comparison.
